note: Adult reference intakes, Annex XIII PART B - the table is headed "(ADULTS)" and the regulation supplies no children's or age-banded equivalent. Same standing as fsa-thresholds.json: on 2026-08-17 all eight values were transcribed three times independently and blind from the consolidated text on EUR-Lex, and an adversarial reader failed to find a single error. Two things the regulation says that this file cannot: energy is ONE cell reading "8 400 kJ/2 000 kcal", so the two numbers here are literals and must never be derived from each other (8400 kJ is about 2008 kcal, not 2000); and the absence of a reference intake for fibre or for the unsaturated fats is a legal fact rather than missing data. Still 'unverified' because no human has opened Annex XIII. Presented neutrally in the UI as percentages - never as "you have used up X% of your day". See docs/REFERENCE_VERIFICATION.md.
